message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine crimes based on Chinese criminal law. Facts: Defendant Zheng made counterfeit "COACH" trademark signs without permission, 20,200 items, accepted commission, received deposit. This is illegal manufacturing of trademark signs, i.e., infringement of trademark rights. Under Chinese law, crimes: "侵犯商标专用权罪" (Trademark infringement) – specifically "非法制造、销售侵犯注册商标专用权的商品罪". The law: Criminal Law Article 210 (2) (illegal manufacturing, selling counterfeit goods). So the crime is "非法制造、销售侵犯注册商标专用权的商品罪". Also possibly "伪造、变造商标罪"? But the act is manufacturing counterfeit trademark signs, which is covered by "侵犯注册商标专用权罪" (illegal manufacturing). The fact includes acceptance of commission, receipt of deposit, but no mention of sale, just manufacturing. The crime may be "非法制造侵犯注册商标专用权的商品罪". Also could be "侵犯著作权罪"? No.

Thus single crime.
